Let me check if there are more pages.

These are all "For Dinner" requests made yesterday evening. Each owes me $5 less, so the corrected amount is $45 each. Let me delete them and create new ones.
All deleted. Now let me create new payment requests with the corrected amount ($50 - $5 = $45 each), keeping everything else the same.

All done. I deleted the 5 "For Dinner" payment requests made yesterday evening ($50 each) and created new ones for $45 each (corrected amount, $5 less) to the same people: Tammy Weaver, Cory Wilson, Debra Ritter, Kathryn Maldonado, and Katie Simpson.
